name: plex-exporter
description: Puts your Plex server's streams, transcodes, bandwidth and library sizes into Prometheus, so you can watch them in Grafana and get alerts. Shows who is watching what, on which device, and whether it plays directly or is transcoded. Tracks each stream's bandwidth and bitrate, counts the items, length and disk space of each library, and adds host CPU, memory and total bandwidth on a server with Plex Pass. A Grafana dashboard and nine alert rules ship in the project repository. It only reads from Plex and has no web UI of its own.

ports.name: Metrics port
ports.description: Prometheus metrics at /metrics and health at /api/health

variables.name: Plex URL
variables.description: Full URL of your Plex Media Server including scheme and port, for example http://192.0.2.100:32400

variables.name: Plex Token
variables.description: Plex authentication token of the server administrator. Plex's guide: https://support.plex.tv/articles/204059436-finding-an-authentication-token-x-plex-token/

variables.name: Plex CA certificate path
variables.description: Only for an https Plex URL with a self-signed or private-CA certificate. The path of the CA PEM file inside the container, with a matching path mapping
